parameters.name: Addresses
parameters.description: The addresses of the office applications. You can enter up to 1,000 addresses of office applications.

parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the office application. You can obtain the value by calling the following operations:

*   [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): queries office applications.
*   [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): creates an office application.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the office application. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

parameters.name: L7Config
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter. The parameter specifies the configurations of Layer 7 applications.

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainAutomaticPrefix
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter. The parameter specifies the prefix of the domain name that the proxy gateway uses. The prefix must be 3 to 20 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainCustom
parameters.description: The browser access mode parameter. The parameter specifies the custom domain name of the proxy gateway.

parameters.name: L7ProxyDomainPrivate
parameters.description: 浏览器访问模式参数：私有代理域名。

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The modification type of the office application. Valid values:

*   **Cover**: uses the values of the **Addresses**, **PortRanges**, and **TagIds** parameters to overwrite the original addresses, port ranges, and tag IDs. This is the default value.
*   **Append**: adds the values of the **Addresses**, **PortRanges**, and **TagIds** parameters respectively to the original addresses, port ranges, and tag IDs.

parameters.name: PortRanges
parameters.description: The port ranges of the office applications. You can enter up to 65,535 port ranges. Multiple port ranges cannot be duplicated or overlapped.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol that is used by the office application. Valid values:

*   **All**
*   **TCP**
*   **UDP**

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the office application. Valid values:

*   **Enabled**
*   **Disabled**

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the tags for the office applications. You can add up to six custom tags to an office application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas update-private-access-application --application-id pa-application-e12860ef6c480000 --description '这是一条内网访问应用' --addresses 192.168.0.0/16 --port-ranges Begin=80 End=81 --protocol All --status Enabled --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --modify-type Cover --l7-proxy-domain-automatic-prefix app1-xxx --l7-proxy-domain-custom app1.example.com --l7-proxy-domain-private app1.example.com --l7-config example-string --config-mode example-string --address-groups '["example-string"]' --name example-string --unauthorized-access-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas UpdatePrivateAccessApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --PortRanges.1.Begin 80 --Description '这是一条内网访问应用' --UnauthorizedAccessConfig 'example-string' --AddressGroups.1 'example-string' --PortRanges.1.End 81 --Name 'example-string' --ModifyType Cover --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --L7ProxyDomainCustom 'app1.example.com' --L7ProxyDomainPrivate 'app1.example.com' --L7Config 'example-string' --L7ProxyDomainAutomaticPrefix 'app1-xxx' --ConfigMode 'example-string' --Addresses.1 '192.168.0.0/16' --ApplicationId 'pa-application-e12860ef6c480000' --Protocol All --method POST --force
